Native setup writes and digests source bytes; current Store byte installation and prior own-write pre-Commit coldness are unqualified. Cache class A remains numerically INELIGIBLE rather than receiving setup warmth or fixture/limit changes.

Raw time/storage/counts and original Store/spool/resource equations retain actual ownership and availability. Retired Save/monitor extent counters are not current SQL or host lifetime peak proxies; unavailable fields remain visible, with no storage ratio threshold or optimization.
